scope: Offline root-cause fixes based on TYFZA1 factory implementation; no device, full firmware build or full test suite used.

fixes.change: Right-align LOID/password with leading zeros and request LOID type 1 in unsupported-auth NAK.
fixes.validation: tools/trace_stock_oam_auth.py: five factory byte comparisons; C codec ASan/UBSan passed

fixes.change: Apply RelatedPort, effective GEM/T-CONT binding, queue priority and WRR weight through snapshot v4; update PVT and VSTBL; preserve committed MIB on failure; same-value new SET checks backend.
fixes.validation: Factory queue sorting/handoff and PVT/VSTBL comparisons passed; test_omci_queues.c, test_omci_kernel_commit.py, test_itu_evto_upload.py and existing OMCI apply/EVTO checks passed

fixes.change: Keep TIM until pending ownership completes; end an empty requested-TID service period without issuing an unconsumable NI grant.
fixes.factory: stop_sta_xmit:0xe7264 and existing PE queued/in-flight ownership contract
fixes.validation: Old production functions reproduce failures; test_wifi_ps_pending.py and test_wifi_ps_release.py passed

targets: pon-omcid and OMCI Rust static library (ARM64 musl)

open_findings: Class 332 factory module mib_EnhancedSecCtl.so was located and initial oracle output collected, but handshake/KDF/activation lifecycle audit is unfinished. The XGTC SMA bit and non-XGTC MSK success path remain identified implementation gaps, not fixed in this commit.
TX A-MSDU-in-A-MPDU negotiation is not yet propagated from mac80211 params->amsdu to the PE aggregation decision. Factory OnAction_back evidence was located; implementation is unfinished.
CTC VLAN business Set remains unsupported (0x87).
Cached successful OMCI retransmissions retain the existing callback-skipping behavior; the recovery fix covers new transactions with unchanged MIB values.
Offline comparisons do not prove complete OLT interoperability or elimination of every sustained high-load Wi-Fi loss.
